translationRepairs: Mi said: "Deciding victory between two battle lines—alas, in a shout or a sigh, enough to terrify the enemy—I am not your equal.
Mi said: "Deciding victory between two battle lines—in a shout or a sigh, enough to terrify the enemy—I am not your equal.
噫嗚咄嗟 is an instantaneous shout, not a lament; 'alas' invents regret absent from 密曰：「決兩陣之勝，噫嗚咄嗟」.

If we march in force on Ji and seize its throat, Goguryeo will hold him on one front and we on the other. In less than ten days his supplies will run out. Raise the banner and summon him, and his whole army can be taken. Then issue proclamations southward and the realm will be settled—that is the best plan.

If we march in force on Ji and seize its throat, Goguryeo will hold him on one front and we on the other. In less than ten days or a month his supplies will run out. Raise the banner and summon him, and his whole army can be taken. Then issue proclamations southward and the realm will be settled—that is the best plan.
不旬月 is a xun-to-month span, so 'ten days' alone drops 月; 'ten days or a month' restores both 旬 and 月.
Mi told his confidants, "Xuangan delights in turning back and does not plan for victory. We shall become captives!"
Mi told his confidants, "Xuangan delights in revolt and does not plan for victory. We shall become captives!"
好反而不圖勝 means he is fond of revolt without planning to win; 'turning back' misreads 反 as a retreat.
Mi said to those close to him: "Xuangan delights in turning back and does not plan for victory—we shall become captives!"
Mi said to those close to him: "Xuangan delights in revolt and does not plan for victory—we shall become captives!"
The literal repeats the same error: 好反 is revolt, not turning back, in 玄感好反而不圖勝.
They brought out all their gold and showed it to the supervising escort. "Since we are about to die," they said, "we beg you to accept this in gratitude."
They brought out all their gold and showed it to the supervising escort. "Since we are about to die," they said, "we beg you to repay this kindness."
幸報德 asks the escort to repay kindness, so 'accept this in gratitude' is wrong; 'repay us this kindness' is awkward—repay this kindness is the natural wording.
If you take the Xingluo Granary directly, open the grain to relieve the destitute, a force of a million can rally to you in a morning, and the enterprise of a true king is accomplished."
If you take the Xingluo Granary directly, open the grain to relieve the destitute, a force of a million can rally to you in a morning, and the enterprise of a king of frost is accomplished."
霜王之業 is not a 'true king', so the original omits 霜; hyphenated 'frost-king' is awkward. Use the chapter's own 'king of frost' wording.
In the fourth month, Sui Tiger Cage General Pei Renji and Huaiyang Prefect Zhao Tuo surrendered, and Meng Rang of the Changbai Mountain bandits came with his followers to join Mi.
In the fourth month, Sui Hulao General Pei Renji and Huaiyang Prefect Zhao Tuo surrendered, and Meng Rang of the Changbai Mountain bandits came with his followers to join Mi.
虎牢 is Hulao Pass; 隋虎牢將 is the Sui general at Hulao, not a 'Tiger Cage' calque of 虎 and 牢.
In the fourth month, Sui Tiger Cage General Pei Renji and Huaiyang Prefect Zhao Tuo surrendered; Meng Rang of Changbai Mountain bandits came with his followers to join Mi.
In the fourth month, Sui Hulao General Pei Renji and Huaiyang Prefect Zhao Tuo surrendered; Meng Rang of Changbai Mountain bandits came with his followers to join Mi.
The literal likewise calques 虎牢 as Tiger Cage; Hulao General matches 隋虎牢將.
